content: Cloudflare Turnstile: client renders widget (managed/invisible mode), produces single-use token in hidden input 'cf-turnstile-response', valid 300s. Server MUST call Cloudflare's siteverify API (POST https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify with secret+response+remoteip) before trusting the submission — client-side presence of a token proves nothing alone. NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix needed for the site key; secret key stays server-only env var.
